From the parent: I reviewed checkpoint 735ee27641. One soundness correction and one efficiency fix belong in jvm_context.rs before I hand it to Stage C. Do them first, as a second checkpoint.

1. Soundness, ledger item M10. At the default-import call site (~6904-6910), a Callable reference's `jvm-default-import-package-open` gap is suppressed by a Callable-only zero. Kotlin can resolve a call's lookup N through package P in three ways:
   - a function N;
   - a property N, including an extension property, of a function type plus `invoke`;
   - without an explicit receiver, the constructor of a top-level type N.
   A Value reference N can also be an object declaration named N. So a zero for one category does not close the route.
   Rule:
   - Suppress the gap for a reference only when the selected sole Kotlin package owner certifies absence of N in EVERY category this route can supply for that reference: callable, value AND type, where type means a top-level type P.N, using the package owner's types_complete with its enumerated nested types.
   - The single exception: you may drop a category for a reference kind if you show, with file:line evidence, that the category has its own independent route and gap for that same reference. Report any exception you take; do not assume one.
   - Key certified_zero by lookup over the conjunction, not by (lookup, namespace).
   - The producer therefore needs a package-owner type inventory (types_complete plus the enumerated top-level type names) under the same loss accounting. Add it to your producer scope. Without it, site 212 cannot close, and the gap correctly stays.
2. Efficiency. jvm_kotlin_package_zeros scans every shard's declaration types once per demand, both for the owner check and for selected_claims. Compute both once per distinct package per call. The positive path's per-member owner scan (~6112-6126) gets the same treatment where it is cheap to share. Keep everything query-local; no persisted or cross-query structure.
3. The doc comment says the read "uses the same selected transaction and end-of-query revalidation as positive member reads". In PROGRESS.md, cite the file:line where the positive package-member read is revalidated. Your queued tests must include a provider-deactivation or shadow case that shows the zero becomes Open.
